title: Kindergarten Life Skills — Safe and Healthy Everyday Choices
subject: General Knowledge and Life Skills
description: Practice with questions on handwashing, trusted adults, helmets, hygiene.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: What should you wear when riding a bike?
What should you use to wash your hands?
Where should you cough if you have no tissue?
What can you do if you see broken glass?
choices: stay back and tell an adult
pick it up in bare hands

questions.question: What should you do before crossing a street?
choices: stop and check for traffic with your adult

questions.question: What helps protect teeth every day?
choices: eat candy before bed and skip brushing

questions.question: Which drink helps replace water after running?
How can you keep the sun off your face on a bright day?
choices: wear a hat with a brim

questions.question: You spill water on a floor. What should you do?
choices: cover it with an open book
tell an adult so it can be dried

questions.question: If you find a bottle of medicine, what should you do?
choices: leave it alone and tell a trusted adult

questions.question: When you sit in a car, what helps keep you safe?
choices: holding a book over your face
using the right seat and buckling up

questions.question: What should you do if you get lost in a store?
choices: ask a store worker to help you find your grown-up
follow a shopper to their car

questions.question: After playing with a pet, what should you do before eating?
choices: wipe your hands on someone else

questions.question: Which helps your body rest each night?
choices: keeping the lights on and playing all night

questions.question: If a friend asks you to touch a hot oven, what should you do?
choices: say no and tell an adult
put a paper towel on it
ask another child to touch it first

questions.question: What should you use if your nose needs wiping?
choices: a sleeve you lend to a friend
a shared napkin someone is using

questions.question: Why should you walk near the edge of a pool?
You see a swing moving with someone on it. Where should you wait?
choices: right in front of the swing
off to the side, away from the swing's path

questions.question: Which helps people hear important directions during a school drill?
choices: stay with your class and listen

questions.question: Someone asks you to keep a secret that makes you feel unsafe. What should you do?
